title: Ceasefire share spike -> UAL relief rally
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] GDELT ceasefire GKG share day-over-day pct change > 100 pct triggers an airline relief rally (+); trade long UAL 5d after 1d lag [gdelt.gkg.ceasefire_share -> finance.UAL.log_return]
message: Supported but weak: r=0.052 (n=390), best lag -3d r=0.10, perm p=0.27; long-UAL rule hit rate 48%, OOS avg return negative (-0.26%), actionability 3.32 - not tradeable as specified

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.ceasefire_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long UAL next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] GDELT ceasefire GKG share 20d z-score > 1 leads JETS log returns by 3 days (+) as ceasefire news lifts the whole airline basket, not just UAL; long JETS 3d [gdelt.gkg.ceasefire_share -> finance.JETS.log_return] (parent: R2-0059)
